deleteAccount.title: Delete your Altalaya account
deleteAccount.intro: Everything happens here — no app required. Sign in with your Altalaya account (Google or email), then confirm permanent deletion. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.removesProfile: Your profile and username are removed
deleteAccount.removesSpots: Your viewpoints (spots) and related content are removed
deleteAccount.removesPhotos: Associated photos in storage are removed (best effort)
deleteAccount.keepsReports: Spot reports may be retained when required for legal, security, or dispute reasons

deleteAccount.doneBody: Your Altalaya account and associated personal data have been deleted as described in our Privacy Policy.
